adjudication.rationale: Looking at the save action in embeddable-host.js.es6 lines 29-38, after a successful save, it sets `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`. The categoryId is initialized as null (line 9) and only set when editing an existing host (line 25). For a new host where no category is explicitly selected, categoryId remains null. The server defaults to uncategorized_category_id (line 24 of embeddable_hosts_controller.rb), but the client-side code will set the category to undefined (since findById(null) returns undefined), causing the displayed model to be inconsistent with what the server saved.
